ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the outside is a square, and inside there is a circle; the circle is tangent to the four sides of the outer square. Inside the circle there is also a white square, placed in a diamond shape; its four vertices are respectively at the top, bottom, left, and right positions of the circle, that is, at the points of tangency between the circle and the sides of the outer square. The gray region includes the part inside the circle but outside the inner square, as well as the parts outside the circle in the corners of the outer square. Reasoning: The problem gives the radius of the circle as 1, so the diameter of the circle is 2. The side length of the outer square equals the diameter of the circle, so the area of the outer square is 2^2 = 4. The diagonal of the inner square equals the diameter of the circle, 2, so the area of the inner square is d^2/2 = 2^2/2 = 2. The area of the circle is π·1^2 = π. The shaded area of the circle is the area inside the circle but outside the inner square, namely π - 2. The area between the two squares is the area of the outer square minus the area of the inner square, namely 4 - 2 = 2. Therefore the required ratio is (π - 2)/2 ≈ 0.571, and the closest fraction is 1/2.

method.method_draft: Use global area subtraction. First describe the image: the circle is tangent to all four sides of the outer square, and the inner white square is a diamond whose four vertices lie on the circle at the tangency points. From the text, read that the circle radius is 1. Therefore the outer square side is the circle diameter, 2, so its area is 4. The inner square has diagonal equal to the circle diameter, 2, so its area is d^2/2 = 2. The shaded part of the circle is the area inside the circle but outside the inner square: pi*1^2 - 2 = pi - 2. The area between the two squares is outer square minus inner square: 4 - 2 = 2. The desired ratio is (pi - 2)/2 ≈ 0.571, whose closest listed/simple fraction is 1/2.

method.method_draft: Use quadrant decomposition. First describe the image: the shaded region between the squares splits naturally into four congruent corner regions, and the shaded part inside the circle splits into four congruent circular segments around the diamond. From the text, the circle radius is 1. In each quadrant, the circular segment equals a quarter-circle sector minus the right isosceles triangle formed by two perpendicular radii to adjacent vertices of the inner square: pi/4 - 1/2. Thus the total shaded circle area is 4(pi/4 - 1/2) = pi - 2. Each outer-square corner region is a right isosceles triangle with legs 1 and 1, so its area is 1/2, and all four have area 2. The ratio is therefore (pi - 2)/2 ≈ 0.571, closest to 1/2.

两个正方形之间的区域分成四个角部直角等腰三角形。由于外正方形边长为 2，每个角部三角形的两条直角边都是 1，所以每个面积为 1/2，四个总面积为 2。

因此所求比值为 (π - 2)/2 ≈ 0.571，最接近的分数是 1/2。
